verse_lines: no signal in the wire but the room still sings
every patch a promise every seed a home
the machine keeps a heartbeat when the network is gone
static on the glass and a lamp that will not fade
i keep the loop inside me where the cold cannot reach
chorus_lines: offline let the loop run free
a private little universe that only listens to me
the song stays inside me when the world goes quiet

notes: Two verse lines + one chorus line are drawn per prompt when --with-lyrics is set.
